status: registered before any v3 episode is scored; freeze3.json holds the digests of this file, world3.py and run3.py before the v3 run
supersedes: the phase-B gate of viability-contrast-1. The v2 measurement (README section 3.2) showed the fixed panel cannot certify any decision on this task, so the informative-baseline gate is replaced by the dual-core estimand below, with the floor arms retained as floor controls
inherits_from_v2: data, units, folds, classes, menu pool, per-episode menu, charged-QC rule, budget 16
the score-margin validator: symmetric winsorized Gaussian scoring with pooled fallback; decision at the first step with margin >= tau_arm; abstain at budget end
per-arm tau calibration on training-fold split halves with the tau grid {0,1,2,3,5,8,13,21}, wrong <= 0.05, >= 20 decided calibration episodes
estimand: how much of the clairvoyant ceiling a world-model-guided planner recovers at a certified 5% wrong rate: coverage and conditional wrong of planner arms with different world channels, on identical episodes, menus and budgets

arms.planner_reference: greedy expected-margin planner; predictive per hypothesis = class template N(m_c(L), s_c(L)^2) with pooled fallback; belief w proportional to softmax of the score vector
arms.planner_structural: the same planner; predictive mean per hypothesis adjusted toward the compound's structure-neighbour mean at L: mu_c(L) = (1 - lambda) * m_c(L) + lambda * nn_X(L), with nn_X the Tanimoto-weighted mean AUC of training compounds at L (Morgan fingerprints, radius 2, 2048 bits); lambda fitted per fold on training-half reading log-likelihood over the grid {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0}, applied with the same value to every hypothesis
arms.planner_masked: planner_structural with the compound's fingerprint permuted between episodes within the fold (the one-hot control: the structural channel receives another compound's neighbours; if structural ~= masked the channel is not compound-specific)
arms.planner_shuffled: planner_reference on readings permuted between episodes within the fold (artifact control)

planner_rule: at each step buy the menu line maximising the belief-mixed expected post-reading margin, E[ max_c S_c' - second_c S_c' ], where S' = S + t(a_L) and the expectation mixes the world's predictive over current belief weights at K = 9 Gauss-Hermite-style fixed quantile points per hypothesis; stop and decide when margin >= tau_arm; abstain at budget end
dual_core_questions: agent value with the reference world: planner_reference coverage and conditional wrong against the abstaining floor (fixed/random) and the oracle ceiling
world-model value over the class template: planner_structural - planner_reference correct and coverage at matched tau target
compound specificity of the structural channel: planner_structural - planner_masked
artifact check: planner_shuffled coverage <= 0.10 and correct <= half of planner_reference
calibration on selected actions: observed / forecast wrong-elimination on the episodes the planner decided, per arm (the E-CAL1 optimizer's-curse check, forecast = 1 - softmax top belief at decision)
fit_rules: every template, fingerprint neighbour set, lambda and tau is computed from training folds only; lambda is fitted on the calibration halves' readings
held-out compounds contribute readings only when purchased inside their episode
the oracle and the shuffled/masked arms are diagnostics, never candidates
